posts.title: The Human AI Interface
posts.description: Recently I’ve noticed a weird set of phrases that I had never read before, getting popular. The first one was “defense in-depth”. I’ve been working in web development for 15+ years so that wasn’t a common term for me. I thought: that’s a concise way of putting it. I’ll add it to my dictionary!

posts.title: We need to talk about interactors
posts.description: I’ve noticed a bit of a trend within the Ruby community in recent years that worries me: every other codebase is now attempting to use interactors.
